attack.cost_interpretation: Unconstrained local search stress test; measure actual cost. Not a certified Wasserstein ball.
attack.source: stage5.cem_round with independent attack net IDs; 16 rounds

statistics.claim_gate: observed direction, 95% paired CI, all three seed directions, nominal delta <= 0.002
statistics.comparisons: WDRO minus each of four baselines; retain every degree/distribution/seed
statistics.p95: linear quantile per seed; do not average per-net seed values before taking a tail
statistics.seed_aggregation: mean of separately computed seed metrics
statistics.uncertainty: paired net bootstrap conditional on three fixed trained seeds; not seed-population uncertainty
